gaps: P0: no candidates; P3 has only the 1750 engraving (nothing usable from 1760–1849)
notes: #1 is a later state (Commons says 1574) of the vol. 1 plate, so 1572. #10 is a Canaletto of Westminster Bridge dated 1722 on Commons, impossible (bridge built 1739–50), not used. #31–34 are London, Ontario and New London, Connecticut; #20 is a fort in India. P6 alternative: #36 (Tower of London and the Shard, 2011) if a central view is preferred.
